name: a2val_fixed_seed_replication_ablation_sensitivity_round2
title: Executed Fixed-Seed Replication, Ablation, and Sensitivity Audit for A2 Conditional Controls
hypothesis: The prior round only verified the package environment and inventory. This revision tests the core empirical claim directly by re-executing the existing a2val E1/E2/E3/E5 and optional physical-tangent scripts under a fixed seed matrix, adding the four planned baseline ablation runners and negative-control/threshold sweeps, and reporting seed-level CIs, ablation deltas, sensitivity boundaries, and an explicit missing-run ledger. It does not introduce a new algorithm, model, or hardware claim.
reason: Hit the safety cap of 3 development rounds without the evaluator ever locking (last verdict was still 'revise'). Written up, but not a clean lock.
